title: 第2281章 笃定不甘第2280章 禁锢
slug: 反派不朽帝族族人竟都是老六
content_zh:
“咻！”
可不等禁主多做思索，尖锐破空声在身后响起，他猛然回头寻声望去，入眼便看到了疾驰而来的神主。
对方速度快到不可思议，禁天只觉一道残影从眼前划过，腹部便传出一阵剧痛，他身躯顿时蜷缩在了一起。
“哇！”
禁天猛然张口，喷出一大口鲜血，本就不稳的气息变得越发紊乱，玄冥之气在经脉中四处乱窜，神魂之力流失速度加快。
虚弱感席卷全身，感知到自身的力量越来越弱，禁天只得逆转气血。
霎时间，禁天肉身迅速碰撞，萦绕周身的威严猛然攀升一大截。
“轰隆！”
巨响声轰然响起，禁天肉身直接炸开，恐怖冲击波席卷而出，玄冥帆涌出的黑雾瞬间被冲散。
“该死！”
神主不可避免受到波及，他张口发出一道怒呵声，第一时间构建护体屏障，身躯更是极速朝后方退去。
“咔嚓！”
“碰！”
然而禁天乃极境半步神帝修为，肉身自爆的威力十分恐怖，神主护体屏障仅坚持了不到三息时间，便被气浪震碎。
恐怖冲击波作用在神主身上，他胸膛骨头瞬间塌陷下去，张嘴喷出一大口鲜血，身躯更是径直砸向地面。
“碰！”
神主身躯重重落下，将地面砸出一个直径数十丈的巨坑，一时间烟尘弥漫。
好在神主肉身足够强，虽说受到了禁天自爆冲击波波及，但只是受了一些外伤，他很快便调整好了自身状态。
“刷！”
神主双腿发力，径直从深坑内冲出。

因受禁天自爆影响，方圆百里范围方便满目疮痍，神主对此视若无睹，他眸光快速扫视四周，搜寻禁天的足迹。
神主十分清楚，以禁天的修为，自爆肉身不过是损耗一些本源而已，对方想重新凝聚肉身并不难。
毕竟这片区域幽冥之气浓郁，借助着这些幽冥之气，禁天可以快速恢复。
然而一番扫视下来，神主并未感知到禁天气息，对方如同凭空消失了一般。
察觉到这一异样，神主面色一沉，神情难看到了极点。
本以为这次有玄冥帆在，拿下禁忌生灵一族轻而易举，没想禁天实力提升了这么多，打乱了他的计划。
平复好情绪后。
神主体寒声道：“罢了，无非多花费一些时间而已，没必要生气。”
话音落下，神主便准备顺着一众禁忌生灵残留的气息追寻过去，他坚信只要找到其余禁忌生灵，便可顺藤摸瓜找到禁天。
正当神主准备动身时，怀中的传讯符箓微微震动，散发出淡淡金光。
神主见状脸色微变，传讯符箓散发出金色光芒，这是神灵族最高规格传讯，代表着有大事发生了。
神主不再迟疑，当即动用神念扫视，看完其中信息后，他眉头紧皱在了一起。
content_en:
"Phew!"
But before the Lord of the Forbidden City could think more, a sharp sound broke through the air behind him. He suddenly turned around to look for the sound, and saw the Lord of God speeding towards him.
The opponent's speed was unbelievable. Jin Tian only felt an afterimage passing through his eyes, and there was a sharp pain in his abdomen, and his body suddenly curled up together.
"Wow!"
Ji Tian suddenly opened his mouth and spurted out a large mouthful of blood. His already unstable aura became more and more chaotic. Xuan Ming Qi was rushing around in his meridians, and the loss of divine soul power was accelerating.
A feeling of weakness swept through his body, and he felt that his own strength was getting weaker and weaker, so Jintian had no choice but to reverse his energy and blood.
In an instant, Forbidden Sky's bodies collided rapidly, and the majesty surrounding them suddenly increased a lot.
"Boom!"
A loud noise rang out, Forbidden Sky's physical body exploded directly, a terrifying shock wave swept out, and the black mist pouring out of the Xuan Ming Sail was instantly dispersed.
"Damn it!"
The Lord of God was inevitably affected. He opened his mouth and let out an angry roar. He immediately built a protective barrier, and his body retreated backwards very quickly.
"Crack!"
"Touch!"
However, Ji Tian is a half-step god emperor in the extreme realm, and the power of his body's self-destruction is very terrifying. The god's protective barrier only lasted for less than three breaths before it was shattered by the air wave.
The terrifying shock wave acted on the God Lord, and his chest bones collapsed instantly. He opened his mouth and spurted out a large mouthful of blood, and his body hit the ground directly.
"Touch!"
The God Lord's body fell heavily, creating a huge crater with a diameter of dozens of feet on the ground, and smoke and dust filled the air for a while.
Fortunately, the Divine Lord's physical body was strong enough. Although he was affected by the shock wave of Forbidden Sky's self-destruction, he only suffered some external injuries and he quickly adjusted his condition.
"Brush!"
The Lord God used his legs and rushed straight out of the pit.
Due to the impact of Forbidden Sky's self-destruction, a radius of a hundred miles was devastated. The Lord of God turned a blind eye to this. His eyes quickly scanned the surroundings, searching for Forbidden Sky's footprints.
The Lord of God is very clear that with Jintian's cultivation, self-explosion of the body is just a loss of some origin, and it is not difficult for the other party to re-condensate the body.
After all, this area is rich in Netherworld energy. With the help of this Netherworld energy, Forbidden Sky can recover quickly.
However, after a quick glance, the Divine Lord did not sense the Forbidden Heaven's aura, and the other party seemed to have disappeared out of thin air.
Upon noticing this strangeness, the Lord God's face darkened, and his expression became extremely ugly.
I thought that with Xuan Mingfan here this time, it would be easy to take down the Forbidden Creatures clan, but I didn't expect that Forbidden Sky's strength would increase so much, disrupting his plan.
After calming down.
The main body of God said coldly: "That's all, it just takes more time. There is no need to be angry."
As soon as he finished speaking, the God Lord prepared to follow the remaining auras of the forbidden creatures to pursue the past. He firmly believed that as long as he found the other forbidden creatures, he could follow the clues to find the forbidden sky.
Just as the Lord of God was about to leave, the communication talisman in his arms vibrated slightly and emitted a faint golden light.
The God Lord's face changed slightly when he saw this, and the communication talisman emitted golden light. This was the highest level communication from the Spirit Clan, and it meant that something big had happened.
The Lord of God no longer hesitated, and immediately used his spiritual mind to scan it. After reading the information, he frowned.
